units.source_text: 汉子边走边掸去落在阿笑和服上的一片片竹叶。

en.t: As the man walked, he brushed away the bamboo leaves that had fallen one by one onto Axiao's kimono.

units.source_text: 下到了山涧，他们沿着河滩上的踏脚石，去偷洗温泉旅馆的温泉。

en.t: After descending to the mountain stream, they followed the stepping stones along the riverbank and slipped off to bathe secretly in the hot spring at the inn.
